title: DrawableTexture2D.setup() is empty when using Forward+ and DirectX12. Results in empty transparent Texture without the declared color
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in 4.7.1 & 4.7.2 ### System information Windows 11 - Godot 4.7.2 - DirectX12 Forward+ - AMD RX 7800 XT + AMD Ryzen 7 7800x3d ### Issue description In an empty project using a simple 2D scene that has a node2d as its root and a sprite2D with a script attached: Script has following contents: ```gdscript extends Sprite2D var drawable_text: DrawableTexture2D; var text_size : Vector2i = Vector2i(512, 512) # Called when the node enters the scene tree for the first time. func _ready() -> void: drawable_text = DrawableTexture2D.new() drawable_text.setup(text_size.x, text_size.y, DrawableTexture2D.DRAWABLE_FORMAT_RGBA8_SRGB, Color.AQUA); texture = drawable_text; ``` Result is a empty texture that still responds to blit_rect etc. but doesnt have the background color thats to be expected and is instead transparent no matter what. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create Project 2. Under Project Settings > Select Driver.Windows to d3d12 3. Under Project Settings > Set Renderer to Forward + (forward_plus) 4. Create an empty 2D Scene. 5. Create a Sprite2D 6. Attach a script 7. Post contents given in the description (interestingly it creates an empty white texture if the drawabletexture is created in the editor and not in the code) ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [drawable-texture.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32220801/drawable-texture.zip) Heres the MRP.
